title: Abelian transpose of the ordinary scalar root comparison
statement: In the setting of [lem-sp-tower-restricted-scalar-adjunction], let chi be any section-identity comparison of its specified forgetful direct-image functors; no adjunction a is assumed. Suppose every middle component of d.kummer equals unitsPull(f) [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback], and let theta1 be normalized LinePullback data [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. The source composite scalar/geometric adjunct of theta1.hom, after UY and chi at the scalar-extended root module on X, equals the abelian adjunct of d.forgetIso at cY.rootModule followed by UX of the target scalar adjunct of EX(d.rootIso.hom). This is an equality of abelian tower maps, without any scalar-association isomorphism or coefficient-unit equation.

proof.text: The first Kummer square and the hypothesis on the middle component identify the root component with restriction of actual roots: both maps have the same composite into full units, and the target Kummer inclusion is monic. d.kummer_roots identifies this root component with the forgotten map induced by d.forgetIso and d.rootIso.

proof.text: Transpose under the componentwise abelian adjunction and use chi on sections. The normalized ordinary scalar unit inserts one tensor the root. The unique lineEvaluation sends this generator to the finite Tate tensor with scalar one. The theta1 normalization gives exactly one tensor the restricted root. The ordinary scalar/tensor universal property identifies the additive maps, and evaluation at every level gives the whole-tower equality.

theorem scalarRoot_abelianTranspose
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX)
    (χ : (g.push ⋙ SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)) ⋙ cY.reduction.forget.F ≅
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E X) ⋙ cX.reduction.forget.F) ⋙ abPush f)
    (hχ : ∀ (N : Systems X (Arings l E X)) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (((cY.reduction.forget.F.obj
        ((SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)).obj (g.push.obj N))).obj (op n)).obj.obj U)),
      HEq ((((χ.hom.app N).app (op n)).hom.app U) x) x)
    (hk : ∀ n : ℕ, d.kummer.τ₂.app (op n) = (unitsPull f).app (op n))
    (θ₁ : LinePullback l E f g cY cX) :
    cY.reduction.forget.F.map
        (((cY.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.comp g.ordinaryAdjunction).homEquiv _ _)
          θ₁.iso.hom) ≫ χ.hom.app (lineModule l E cX) =
      ((abAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _)
        (d.forgetIso.hom.app cY.rootModule ≫ cX.reduction.forget.F.map
          ((cX.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _)
            (cX.scalar.model.E.map d.rootIso.hom)))
